verdicts.reason: A is broken: the headline is crammed into the top-left of a mostly empty red block with a stray line crossing 'MODERN', the author sits as a disconnected fragment on the right, and the skyline is shrunk and floats in a white panel, so the design is no longer recognisable. B keeps the original composition (white frame, red panel, centred headline, author, skyline) letterboxed on a grey field. The text is small but readable. The skyline crowds the author line and the red panel bottom, and the wide grey margins are wasted, but it is clearly the same design.
